meta.name: ubiquitous-language
meta.description: Extract a DDD-style ubiquitous language glossary from the current conversation, flagging ambiguities and proposing canonical terms. Saves to UBIQUITOUS_LANGUAGE.md. Use when user wants to define domain terms, build a glossary, harden terminology, create a ubiquitous language, or mentions "domain model" or "DDD".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从对话中提取领域术语并生成术语表
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果在用DDD开发时想统一团队术语并消除歧义
copy.tagline_en: Extract domain terms from conversation and generate a glossary
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to unify team terminology and eliminate ambiguity while doing DDD

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会从对话中提取领域术语，整理成统一术语表，保存到 UBIQUITOUS_LANGUAGE.md 文件，并指出歧义和推荐标准术语。
howto.when: 当用户要求定义领域术语、构建术语表、统一术语、创建通用语言，或提到“领域模型”“DDD”时触发。

say.text: 帮我把对话中的领域术语整理成术语表。
say.note: Claude 会扫描对话并生成术语表文件。

say.text: 检查一下我们用的术语有没有歧义。
say.note: Claude 会识别同词异义或同义异词的问题。

say.text: 更新术语表，加入刚才讨论的新概念。
say.note: Claude 会读取已有文件并补充新术语。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude extracts domain-relevant terms from the conversation, compiles a consistent glossary, saves it to UBIQUITOUS_LANGUAGE.md, and flags ambiguities with recommended canonical terms.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to define domain terms, build a glossary, harden terminology, create a ubiquitous language, or mentions "domain model" or "DDD".

say_en.text: Extract domain terms from our conversation into a glossary.
say_en.note: Claude scans the conversation and generates a glossary file.

say_en.text: Check if any terms are used ambiguously.
say_en.note: Claude identifies same word for different concepts or synonyms.

say_en.text: Update the glossary with the new concepts we just discussed.
say_en.note: Claude reads the existing file and adds new terms.
